== Altis ==

=== Atlantis ===

{{Feature|quote|There is a myth that remnants of an ancient civilization lies underwater near the coast of Altis|{{arma3}} loading screen}}
"Atlantis" can be found at '''150068''' ({{Link|https://www.youtube.com/watch?v{{=}}SUM-N_p3kbc&t{{=}}1m14s|source}})

=== Stonehenge ===

[[Altis]] also has its (nicer) Stonehenge with a decorative skull on the top, located in the North-East corner of '''144061''' at Cape Makrinos.

=== Rocky hideout ===

A hidden hideout (and what is supposedly its owner's skeleton) can be found at '''080094''' ({{Link|https://www.youtube.com/watch?v{{=}}SUM-N_p3kbc&t{{=}}2m13s|source}})
<!--

Can be found at location x, y and z

=== TRPASLIK ===

'''TRPASLIK''' is written with rocks on the bottom of the sea at '''229061''' ({{Link|https://www.youtube.com/watch?v{{=}}SUM-N_p3kbc&t{{=}}25s|source}})
{{Link|link= https://forums.bohemia.net/profile/826110-trpaslik/|text= Trpaslik}} is Altis' Environment Designer ({{Link|https://arma3.com/news/report-in-radim-vitek-petr-sedlacek-environment|REPORT IN}}).


== Stratis ==

=== Pirate hideout ===

{{Feature|quote|According to legend, there is a hidden cave somewhere on the coast of Stratis, rumored to contain treasures hidden by the Arabian pirates.|{{arma3}} loading screen}}
The mentioned '''Pirate Cave''' is located at '''042073''' ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v{{=}}a03c1WLZVu8&t{{=}}27s how-to video])

=== V-22 Osprey wreck ===

The '''V-22 Osprey''' wreck found South of [[Stratis]] airport (coordinates '''014047''') is a nod to {{arma2}}'s vehicle ({{Link|https://www.youtube.com/watch?v{{=}}a03c1WLZVu8&t{{=}}2m01s|video}})


== Malden 2035 ==

=== Stonehenge ===

[[Operation Flashpoint: Easter Eggs#Mysterious_Stonehenge|Same as in {{ofp}}]], [[Malden 2035]] has its own {{Link|https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stonehenge}}, located in the North-West corner of '''058101''' coordinates.

[[File:Arma_3_Bushlurker_tribute_statue.jpg|thumb|Dedicated to Paul “Bushlurker” Pelosi (1960-2017)]]
=== The Bushlurker Monument ===

{{Feature|quote|In the beginning, there was no clutter... Only bushes...}}
At '''027074''' lays a monument in tribute to {{Link|link= https://forums.bohemia.net/forums/topic/201520-paul-%E2%80%9Cbushlurker%E2%80%9D-pelosi-1960-2017-rest-in-peace/|text= Paul “Bushlurker” Pelosi (1960-2017)}} who has worked on many community terrains, including Malden for [[Cold War Rearmed 2|CWR2]]. He passed away some months before Malden 2035's release.

{{Link|link= https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=843661230|text= The statue}} itself was made by {{Link|link= https://forums.bohemia.net/profile/796144-kiory/|text= Kiory}} and announced on the {{Link|link= https://forums.bohemia.net/forums/topic/201637-the-bushlurker-monument/|text= forums}}, and was later {{Link|https://twitter.com/projectargogame/status/867036354617761797|implemented officially}}.
